title: CLI Prompt Submission Fails with HTTP 400 Error
body:
**Bug Description**
I can successfully run prompts only if I run it from terminal via `claude "prompt"` if I try to do subsequent prompt through CLI UI I'm getting HTTP 400 errors.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: zsh
- Version: zsh 5.9 (arm64-apple-darwin24.0)
- Feedback ID: 18a878f6-b4d9-4960-af5e-1ccff71a3ebc

**Errors**
```json
[ API Error: 400 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message"]
```
author: viktorbezdek
